visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a concert promotional poster on a white wall; a white circular graphic is overlaid on a specific portrait. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the text and artist images on the poster. (2) A young man with short, styled black hair wearing a denim shirt over a white tee appears in frame; he is looking down at a cue card with a focused expression in a bright indoor hallway. (3) The man looks up with an expression of urgency and begins to run down a gray concrete staircase; the camera follows his movement handheld, maintaining a medium shot. The white circle graphic stays centered on the screen. (4) He runs through a door into a backstage environment containing black equipment cases and coiled cables; a hand enters from the side to hand him a black microphone which he grabs while moving. (5) The man enters a large stage illuminated by pink and purple spotlights; he waves his arm towards a large crowd of silhouetted audience members. A large white LED screen and a drum set are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a single, sharp digital 'ding' sound effect against a quiet noise floor. (2) Immediately following the ding, a high-tempo EDM track with a thick synthesizer bassline and a driving 4/4 electronic drum beat starts. The music is bright and high-energy with no vocals. (3) Rapid, rhythmic thumping sounds of heavy footsteps on a hard surface are audible, panning slightly with the motion. Faint fabric rustling is heard as the speed increases. (4) The acoustic space expands as a sudden burst of high-intensity crowd noise, consisting of cheering and screaming, enters the mix. (5) A male voice projects loudly over the music and crowd with an excited, high-pitched tone, shouting '大家晚安!' The music remains at a consistent, energetic volume until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous POV setup to show the host rushing backstage to a concert stage. It leverages the visual of a white circle as a 'button' that the viewer supposedly presses to make the video speed up or the host move faster, creating a sense of interactive urgency and comedic payoff when he finally arrives at the cheering crowd.
